title: How does OpenAI Caching Tokens Work?

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on the Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看這支介紹 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 影片。

cues.en: Today, we're going to look into OpenAI and its caching tokens and how they work.
cues.zh: 今天要介紹 OpenAI 的快取 Token，以及它們如何運作。

cues.en: So, let's jump into it.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: So, here I have some sample code and a small prompt.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些範例程式碼與簡短提示詞。

cues.en: In that, we just make an Azure OpenAI client here.
cues.zh: 先建立 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: We could use OpenAI client, they work exactly the same.
cues.zh: 也可以用 OpenAIClient，運作方式完全相同。

cues.en: We are going to give our model a little text with some aromatic equations, and we tell it this is the only knowledge it has.
cues.zh: 接著給模型一小段算術題文字，並告訴它這是唯一可用的知識。

cues.en: Then we are starting a session, and we are going in and writing out the answer, of course, but also the token count.
cues.zh: 然後建立 session，除了輸出答案，也輸出 Token 數量。

cues.en: And we're using GPT-5 Mini here, and the price is in million tokens,
cues.zh: 這裡使用 GPT-5 mini，價格以每百萬 Token 計算，

cues.en: and it would be 0.25, and then we can see caching is one-tenth of that.
cues.zh: 輸入是 0.25，而快取輸入只有十分之一。

cues.en: Then we have output, and reasoning is part of output.
cues.zh: 另外是輸出，推理 Token 也包含在輸出中。

cues.en: We're not really going into reasoning today, but I've just put it out so we have all four of these.
cues.zh: 今天不深入推理，但先把四種用量都顯示出來。

cues.en: So, if we ask our AI here, what is this text about?
cues.zh: 先問 AI：「這段文字在說什麼？」

cues.en: What we will see is we get our answer back.
cues.zh: 接著就會取得答案。

cues.en: And because this is our first question, we don't get any cache or anything.
cues.zh: 因為是第一次提問，所以沒有任何快取。

cues.en: It's just the input and the output, and much of it was reasoning.
cues.zh: 只有輸入與輸出，而且大部分輸出用在推理。

cues.en: Probably wouldn't need reasoning for this specific question, but just so we have all of it.
cues.zh: 這個問題其實可能不需要推理，只是為了把資訊完整呈現。

cues.en: And we can do a follow-up question.
cues.zh: 接著可以追問：

cues.en: Are the answers correct?
cues.zh: 「裡面的答案正確嗎？」

cues.en: And we will get back that, yes, they are correct, but what you will notice is we didn't hit the cache.
cues.zh: 它會回答正確，但你會發現，沒有命中快取。

cues.en: So, the cache didn't work.
cues.zh: 所以快取沒有發揮作用。

cues.en: Does that mean we need to set some settings over here? Why is that?
cues.zh: 這代表需要額外設定嗎？為什麼會這樣？

cues.en: Well, we don't need to set any settings.
cues.zh: 其實不需要設定。

cues.en: Caching is on by default, but caching is only happening when we hit a thousand or more tokens in terms of OpenAI.
cues.zh: 快取預設已開啟，但 OpenAI 只有在輸入大約一千個 Token 以上時才會使用快取。

cues.en: So, because we were below that, they, being OpenAI or Azure in this case,
cues.zh: 因為這次低於門檻，所以 OpenAI，或這裡的 Azure，

cues.en: didn't go in and use the cache because probably it's too much of a hassle for very, very low token counts and would hurt our performance.
cues.zh: 不會使用快取；太短的內容可能不值得處理，反而影響效能。

cues.en: So, they have chosen 1,000 to be when you begin, and you can't really change that.
cues.zh: 所以他們設定了大約一千的門檻，而且無法自行更改。

cues.en: So, in order for us to see caching, we need to go in and use a longer text.
cues.zh: 因此要觀察快取，就需要更長的文字。

cues.en: So, in my case, I have a book here.
cues.zh: 這裡我準備了一本書的內容。

cues.en: It's a prefix of Pride and Prejudice, and then the first chapter.
cues.zh: 包含《傲慢與偏見》的前言與第一章。

cues.en: It's roughly 500 lines of text.
cues.zh: 大約五百行文字。

cues.en: And the reason for a longer text is, of course, to hit over that 1,000 token limit.
cues.zh: 使用較長內容，當然是為了超過一千個 Token 的門檻。

cues.en: So, if we go in and ask again, what is this text about?
cues.zh: 再次詢問：「這段文字在說什麼？」

cues.en: We will now see that once it's come back, and it will take a little longer now because we have a longer text, it comes back and gives us a summary of what that text is about.
cues.zh: 這次因為文字較長，會多花一點時間；回覆後，就會取得文字內容的摘要。

cues.en: And we can see our input here is almost 10,000 tokens.
cues.zh: 可以看到，輸入接近一萬個 Token。

cues.en: So, we are above when caching should go into effect.
cues.zh: 已經超過應該啟用快取的門檻。

cues.en: So, right now, it has actually cached some of our tokens and are on their servers.
cues.zh: 因此現在，部分 Token 已經快取在服務端。

cues.en: Their servers being Azure, in this case, but also OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這裡是 Azure，也同樣適用 OpenAI。

cues.en: So, if we do a follow-up question to this, we can see that we have 1,000 tokens.
cues.zh: 接著追問，就可以觀察快取。

cues.en: If we do a follow-up question to this, what characters are in Pride and Prejudice?
cues.zh: 例如：「《傲慢與偏見》有哪些角色？」

cues.en: We will get that back.
cues.zh: 它會回覆答案。

cues.en: And we don't really care about what it says here.
cues.zh: 這裡不特別關心回答內容。

cues.en: We are interested in seeing that of the 9,800 tokens in total, we added a little more because we added more questions.
cues.zh: 重點是總共約 9,800 個輸入 Token，比剛才稍多，因為增加了對話內容。

cues.en: We saw that 9,600 of them were cached, meaning we paid only one-tenth of the price for those.
cues.zh: 其中 9,600 個是快取 Token，也就是這些部分只需支付十分之一的輸入價格。

cues.en: And that's because whenever our question and answer is exactly the same,
cues.zh: 這是因為重複送出的請求前綴完全相同，

cues.en: and in this case, this text is exactly the same as we sent it the first time,
cues.zh: 這裡的書籍文字也和第一次送出的內容一模一樣，

cues.en: it doesn't need to predict the next token for each one of those 9,600 tokens.
cues.zh: 所以不必重新處理那 9,600 個 Token 的全部計算。

cues.en: But it needed to predict the rest.
cues.zh: 只需要處理後面不同的部分。

cues.en: So, if we asked,
cues.zh: 例如再問：

cues.en: who is Darcy?
cues.zh: 「Darcy 是誰？」

cues.en: We will again see that our cache is quite high.
cues.zh: 仍然可以看到很高的快取命中數。

cues.en: So, again, we only really paid a 0.25 in the difference between these two.
cues.zh: 因此只有兩者之間新增的那一小部分，才按完整的 0.25 費率計算。

cues.en: So, this is really good, we don't need to do anything, but of course, for the small cases, we don't get any caching value,
cues.zh: 這很好，完全不需要額外處理；短內容雖然沒有快取優惠，

cues.en: but that doesn't matter too much.
cues.zh: 但影響也不大。

cues.en: So, this is good.
cues.zh: 所以是個不錯的功能。

cues.en: One interesting thing is that if I restart this, we are in a new session, and if I say, what is this text about?
cues.zh: 有趣的是，重新啟動程式、建立新的 session，再問「這段文字在說什麼？」

cues.en: What we will see is that it's actually still caching.
cues.zh: 仍然會命中快取。

cues.en: So, the cache is in per API key we use.
cues.zh: 所以這個快取是依使用的 API 金鑰範圍運作。

cues.en: So, even between sessions, if we ask exactly the same thing, we will get the same.
cues.zh: 即使跨 session，只要送出相同內容，仍然能使用快取。

cues.en: But if we go into the book and put in something different here,
cues.zh: 但如果修改書籍開頭的文字，

cues.en: we lose our cache.
cues.zh: 就會失去快取。

cues.en: So, if we do this, what is this text about?
cues.zh: 再問一次：「這段文字在說什麼？」

cues.en: And because I changed the first character, it's not the same text anymore, the cache is missed, and we see that we end up using full input.
cues.zh: 因為第一個字元變了，前綴不再相同，所以沒有命中快取，必須完整計算輸入。

cues.en: So, what if I go down here and in the middle, just type something in there?
cues.zh: 那如果改到中間，加入一些文字呢？

cues.en: Let's see how that affects our cache.
cues.zh: 看看對快取的影響。

cues.en: Here we can see we can cache up to this area, so this was the 1100.
cues.zh: 可以看到，修改位置之前的部分仍能快取，這裡大約有 1,100 個 Token。

cues.en: So, it's only when something changes, but if we have exactly the same text, then we get the cache.
cues.zh: 因此只有變更前的相同前綴能命中；文字相同就能使用快取。

cues.en: If you go see OpenAI's documentation, they talk about caching, caching, caching, caching, caching, caching, caching,
cues.zh: 到 OpenAI 文件查看，可以找到很多關於快取的說明，

cues.en: They talk about caching being there for like 5-10 minutes until inactivity, and no matter what, the cache will go away after an hour.
cues.zh: 文件提到，閒置約五到十分鐘後可能清除，而且最遲一小時後會清除。

cues.en: So, of course, they need to keep that up in memory, up in their servers, so cache is fleeting,
cues.zh: 畢竟它們得把資料保留在伺服器記憶體中，所以快取不是永久的，

cues.en: but it will stay around long enough for a follow-up question like this.
cues.zh: 但通常足夠支援這類接續提問。

cues.en: And everything is transparent, you don't need to write any specific code
cues.zh: 整個過程對程式是透明的，不必撰寫特別的程式碼，

cues.en: in order to hit the cache, so they're just giving you long text cheaper automatically.
cues.zh: 就會自動用較便宜的價格處理重複的長文字。

cues.en: And it's roughly this tenth of a price every time we do caching, but, of course, we pay more because we spend more.
cues.zh: 快取輸入大約只要十分之一的價格；當然，內容越多，總費用還是會增加。

cues.en: So, that is actually everything how caching works.
cues.zh: 以上就是快取的運作方式。

cues.en: You don't need to be worried that you need to do anything, it just works out of the box, which is cool.
cues.zh: 不用擔心需要額外設定，它預設就能使用，非常方便。

cues.en: So, that's everything, see you on the next one.
cues.zh: 這次就到這裡，我們下支影片見。
